builder.title: Your menu. Your pace.
builder.intro: Your combination, your portions. Build your plate with protein, carbs, vegetables and sauces to suit your appetite and goals. See the cost and nutritional values as you choose.
builder.instructions: Choose one option from each category, then select your portion. You can skip any category. The price and nutritional totals update automatically in the summary.
builder.empty: Start with your favourite ingredient. Your combination, portions and total cost will appear here.
builder.noDeclaredAllergens: None declared on the menu. For allergies, please ask our team.
builder.orderNote: This is a calculator, not an online order. Show your combination to the ALIVE team and confirm availability and pricing at the bistro.
builder.nutritionNote: Totals add the declared values for each serving in the supplied menu, without extrapolating to other sizes. Fat is not totalled: protein options only list fat per 100 g, not per serving. For allergies or specific dietary needs, please ask our team.

hero.subtitle: The perfect balance between <span1>nutritious food</span1>, <span2>specialty coffee</span2>, and <span3>community</span3>.

story.title: food with purpose, well-being and daily energy<1>.</1>
story.p1: <1>Alive</1> is a modern Bistro concept built around the idea of balance between good food, specialty coffee, functional drinks, energy, healthy lifestyle, and community.
story.p2: We do not want to build another rigid or elitist 'healthy' venue, but a warm, accessible, and authentic space where people can naturally integrate better habits into their daily lives.
story.p3: Alive will function as both a bistro and coffee spot, as well as a space for socializing, working, relaxing, and education around wellness and mindful nutrition.

pillars.subtitle: What You'll Discover at Alive
pillars.title: more than a bistro: a lifestyle<1>.</1>
pillars.p1_desc: A premium selection of specialty coffee, hot breakfast dishes, nourishing soups, and delicious main courses.
pillars.p2_desc: Fresh smoothies, protein shakes, and functional drinks with natural supplements dedicated to performance and well-being.
pillars.p3_desc: A warm and bright place where you can work on your laptop, read, or reconnect with friends in a calm atmosphere.

values.subtitle: Mission & Values
values.title: what do we believe in?<1>.</1>
values.description: The mission of <1>Alive</1> is to make a healthy lifestyle feel more natural, balanced, and sustainable. We believe in real food, nutritional supplements, quality ingredients, and experiences that make people feel good and in harmony with themselves.
values.v1_text: Real, tasty, and balanced food. A fine balance between exceptional taste, long-lasting energy, and real nutritional value, without dogmas or rigid restrictions.
values.v2_text: Through themed brunches, wellness educational events, and open discussions about nutrition, we support you in building better daily habits.
values.v3_text: More than a restaurant. We offer a welcoming space for socializing, productive work, relaxation, or a simple refreshing break from the daily hustle.
values.v4_text: We use premium, seasonal ingredients and clean recipes. We tell you exactly what your food and drink contains: from specialty coffee to active supplements.

community.title: the ALIVE community<1>.</1>
community.desc: We aim to be more than just a place to eat excellently. We are a vibrant hub for people passionate about well-being, sports, mindful nutrition, and authentic connection.

pillars.p1_desc: We prepare unique culinary experiences on weekends, with special menus focused on super-nutritive ingredients and delicious pairings with specialty coffee.
pillars.p2_desc: We host discussions on nutrition, workshops on a balanced lifestyle, and interactive sessions with specialists dedicated to your well-being.
pillars.p3_desc: The warm atmosphere transmits calm and good energy. It is the perfect space where you can work relaxed on your laptop, read, or have a great conversation with a friend.

community.collab_desc: If you are a trainer, nutritionist, sports enthusiast, or simply want to organize an event in harmony with our healthy values, we are open to proposals and partnerships!

social.instagram: Daily updates, behind-the-scenes moments from our kitchen, wellness recipes, and stories full of energy.
social.facebook: Event announcements, themed brunches, and news from the well-being community.
social.tiktok: Videos of preparing our functional drinks, nutrition tips, and pure energy.
